depiction.primary_object: desktop computer monitor on a short trapezoidal stand
modifiers: downward-pointing arrow entering from top right
depiction.composition: single object in front view with a cutout on the top-right screen bezel for the downward arrow

readings.meaning: install desktop software or update operating system
download file or application to computer

ambiguity: Completely interchangeable with the monitor-with-downward-arrow on a rectangular stand; also easily mistaken for a generic download tray icon or an upload-to-monitor icon at a quick glance.

modifier_semantics.meaning: download, install, or import onto the device

task_intents: save files locally for offline use

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a desktop monitor with a downward arrow entering the screen, universally understood as downloading to a computer or installing desktop software. It fits a concrete and common set of tech, work, and personal admin tasks (installing apps, updating drivers, saving files locally), though it can slightly overlap with generic download trays or plain monitor icons.
